game.name: Champion Jockey : G1 Jockey & Gallop Racer (Europe)
game.desc: Champion Jockey: G1 Jockey & Gallop Racer is a horse racing simulation for Xbox 360. The game invites you to put on a jockey's hat and climb to the top of the leaderboard. Defend your reputation in Career mode or take part in single or obstacle races, alone or with others online.
game.genre: Simulation, Sports, Horse racing, Sports with animals
